about_short_description.short_description: Etleap is an ETL solution for creating perfect data pipelines from day one.

product.name: Etleap Data Pipeline Platform
product.description: A cloud-native, managed ETL/ELT platform for building, operating, and maintaining data pipelines from diverse sources to warehouses and data lakes.

product.name: Etleap Ingestion
product.description: A managed data ingestion service that continuously transfers data from databases, applications, files, APIs, and event streams into cloud warehouses and data lakes.

product.name: Fully-Managed Iceberg Pipelines
product.description: A managed pipeline solution for ingesting, transforming, and operating Apache Iceberg tables, including automated maintenance and schema evolution.

product.name: Transform and Model
product.description: A data transformation and modeling capability that shapes data in flight through wrangling or builds SQL-based models with dbt Core.

product.name: Custom Data Integrations
product.description: An integration service for connecting Etleap to source systems that are not covered by standard connectors or user-defined API connections.

product.name: Etleap Customer Support
product.description: Technical support for operating Etleap pipelines, including direct access to ETL-capable engineers through private Slack and Microsoft Teams channels.
